meta.title: NearbyNinja — cafés, restaurants and bars nearby in Telegram
meta.description: The top 3 places nearby in a couple of taps: send a spot and get a café, restaurant or bar within 100–1000 m. Free, right in Telegram.

hero.h1: Where to go right now? The top 3 places nearby in a couple of taps
hero.lead: Send a spot and the bot shows the three best cafés, restaurants or bars within walking distance. No endless feeds or reviews.
hero.cta_note: Available in Russian, English and Chinese; the language follows your Telegram.

steps.title: Send a spot
steps.text: Your current location, a point on the map, an address, coordinates or a Google Maps link.

steps.title: Pick filters
steps.text: Radius of 100, 200, 500 or 1000 m, minimum rating and category: cafés, restaurants, bars or everything. The bot remembers your choice.

steps.title: Get the top 3
steps.text: Cards with distance and direction. If fewer than three places are nearby, the radius widens by itself.

items.title: Search in any chat
items.text: Type @{bot} in a conversation, e.g. “@{bot} cafe 1km”, an address or coordinates, and send the place to friends.

items.title: What to try here
items.text: A free card with the city's local dishes and drinks, a how-to-eat tip and a button that finds places serving the dish nearby.

items.title: Votes and “closed” reports
items.text: 👍/👎 votes build a community rating (🥷) for unrated places, and the “🚫 Closed” button hides places that no longer operate.

items.title: A clean list
items.text: The bot filters out closed places, duplicates and non-food venues such as gyms and hotels, and widens the radius when there are too few places.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.free_title: The bot is free for now
pricing.free_text: Search, cards and inline mode are available without payment.
pricing.paid_text: Searches with ratings and real photos: daily streak bonuses, rewards for votes and invited friends, plus packs and Pro access for Telegram Stars.

items.q: Where does the data come from?
items.a: From open and partner sources: Geoapify and OpenStreetMap, and Foursquare for searches with ratings. Data may be inaccurate or outdated: if a place is closed, tap “🚫 Closed”.

items.q: How do I use inline mode on desktop?
items.a: The desktop app does not send your location with inline queries. Send the bot your location in a private chat once, or add an address or coordinates to the query.

items.q: How do I search in another city?
items.a: Tap “🗺 Another point”: choose a place on the map via the paperclip, type an address or coordinates, or send a Google Maps link.
Your location is used only for search and is kept for a few hours at most. See the privacy policy for details.
Use /paysupport in the bot, or /feedback with your payment ID. The terms are on the Terms of Use page.

guides.title: What to try: city guides
guides.lead: Hand-reviewed lists of local dishes and drinks.

p: The bot finds cafés, restaurants and bars near the spot you give and shows data from third-party sources. We do not guarantee its accuracy, freshness or the venues' opening hours.
Do not use the bot for automated data collection or to overload the service. We may restrict access in case of abuse.
For payment issues use the /paysupport command in the bot, or write via /feedback with your payment ID.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.note: A draft prepared by the project owner; it is not legal advice.

p: Your Telegram account ID and language; your search settings (radius, minimum rating, category).
The location or address you send for a search: it is used only for the search and kept for a few hours at most; the last point is kept for inline mode on desktop.
Your 👍/👎 votes and “closed” reports (place ID and your ID), referral links, limit and streak counters, Telegram Stars payment data (payment ID), and the text of your /feedback messages.

To run a search, the coordinates and address are sent to data providers: Geoapify, Foursquare, OpenStreetMap (Overpass, Nominatim) and, as a fallback, Mapbox. For some requests the coordinates are rounded to a cell of about 100 m.
Payments are processed by Telegram. We do not receive bank card data.

We keep aggregate usage statistics: request and feature counters without identifiers and, to count daily active users, the account ID in a set with a limited lifetime. These data are kept for 90 days.
You can request deletion of the data tied to your account via /feedback.
